compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Add alias computation to ticket-create.sh immediately after UUID generation. Makes T2 tests pass.

Implementation:
1. Read adjectives from ticket-wordlist.txt (lines before '# NOUNS')
2. Read nouns from ticket-wordlist.txt (lines after '# NOUNS')
3. Compute alias: adj[int(uuid[0:4],16) % adj_count]-noun[int(uuid[4:8],16) % noun_count]-noun[int(uuid[8:12],16) % noun_count]
4. Write alias to CREATE event data.alias field

Semantic clarification — wordlist-absent fallback:
- If ticket-wordlist.txt is absent or unreadable, alias = first 8 hex chars of UUID (e.g. 'a3f290bc')
- Log 'WARN: wordlist unavailable, using hex fallback alias' to stderr
- Never silently corrupt the event; CREATE event must always have a data.alias field
